title: Inlet Casita
meta_description: Inlet Casita is a 4BR pet-friendly Inlet Beach home with sleeper sofa, open living, bikes, close to public beach, shops, dining, and Frank Brown Park.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Inlet Casita is a charming home in Inlet Beach that is ideal for your next family getaway on 30A. With four bedrooms, including one on the main floor, plus a sleeper sofa in the entertainment space, this home provides plenty of room for a multigenerational family and multiple families visiting together. The open concept living, dining and kitchen space will keep everyone connected during your time at the beach.

\*\*\* Pet Friendly
\*\*\* 3 Blocks to Inlet Public Beach

ABOUT THE AREA: Inlet Beach is conveniently located adjacent to Rosemary Beach and is an easy walk, bike or golf cart ride to Inlet Public Beach, the famous Donut Hole and 30A Avenue Shops featuring 7+ restaurants, boutiques and a yoga studio. For a day of adventure, check Camp Helen State Park (next to Inlet Beach) featuring a coastal dune lake where you can rent kayaks and YOLO paddle boards to take you straight to their pristine beach! There's plenty of parking, restrooms, picnic tables and much more. There is an entry fee of $4 per vehicle. After all the fun in the sun, there are endless dining options at 30Avenue Shops, Barrett's Square in Rosemary, and Pier Park in Panama City Beach. And an added bonus, Inlet Casita is just 9 miles from Frank Brown Park where several youth tournaments are held each year.

BEACH ACCESS: 2-3 blocks to the south on Orange street you are at one of several Inlet beach public access points. One of 30A's best beaches where you have space to spread out as well as important amenities like parking, bathrooms, showers, and lifeguards in the summer season. It's also easy access via a ramp so no stairs to climb.

BEACH ACCESS: At the end of North Orange Street is Inlet Beach. One of 30A's best beaches where you have space to spread out as well as important amenities like parking, bathrooms, showers, and lifeguards in the summer season. It's also easy access via a ramp so no stairs to climb.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King Bed, ensuite bath -- 1st Floor
• Bedroom 2 -- King bed, ensuite bath -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 3 -- Bunk room, (2) sets of twin bunks -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 4 -- Queen bed, 2nd Floor
• Sleeper sofa -- Entertainment area -- 2nd Floor

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Pet Friendly (2 dogs max: 30 lbs or less, $250/pet NR fee)
• 2 Bikes
• 9 miles to Frank Brown Park
• Master on Main
• Sleeper sofa in upstairs entertainment area
• Full Size Laundry Room
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes, etc.
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods, trash bags, kitchen towels, hand soap, bar of soap for shower
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows 2 pets under 50 lbs for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine.

Parking Details:
- This home has 2 parking spaces.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
